Privacy Policy — ORVEN

Last updated: 19 October 2026

1. Who is responsible

ORVEN is operated by Mohamed Hamed and Mohamed El-Hadidy. Contact us about privacy at orven.agency01@gmail.com.

2. Information we handle

If you choose to send a project inquiry, we handle your name, email address or WhatsApp number, optional service preference, and the project details you share. We also record the inquiry reference, language, privacy notice version, and submission time. Please do not include sensitive personal data or confidential client records.

Cloudflare processes technical request and security information to deliver and protect the website. The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile for abuse prevention. ORVEN does not forward your IP address or security token to Google Forms.

3. Purpose and service providers

We use inquiry information to respond to your request, discuss a possible project, and arrange a call. We do not sell it or use it for unrelated marketing.

The website and verification endpoint run on Cloudflare Workers & Pages. A verified inquiry is sent through Google Apps Script to a private Google Form. A Gmail notification is sent to ORVEN after storage; it contains the inquiry reference and a private administration link, rather than a duplicate of your project details. No separate leads database is used.

Cloudflare and Google may process information outside your country under their applicable service terms and safeguards. A future change of provider or processing purpose will be reflected in this notice. If you choose WhatsApp or email, the corresponding provider also processes that conversation.

4. Retention and deletion

Inquiries that do not become projects are scheduled for deletion 30 days after the last actual communication. Automated notifications do not extend that period. Relevant email conversations are associated with the inquiry; calls and WhatsApp contact are recorded by the ORVEN team when they occur.

The scheduled task checks hourly. After the 30-day period, it removes the inquiry from Google Forms, the associated Gmail messages and the registered copies controlled by ORVEN. A failed deletion is retried and flagged for review. No linked response spreadsheet is created by default. If a spreadsheet or export is introduced, it must be included in the copy inventory.

An inquiry that becomes a project is managed under the relevant project and legal retention requirements. A documented legal obligation, regulatory request or dispute can suspend deletion, with a review of that exception every 30 days.

Deletion from active systems does not mean an immediate purge of providers’ restricted backups or a spreadsheet’s revision history. Those copies follow the provider’s deletion mechanisms and any applicable legal restrictions. ORVEN restricts exports and reviews any such residual copy.

5. Security

We use server-side validation, request limits, anti-abuse checks, authenticated server-to-server requests, restricted administrative access, and saved-response confirmation. The website does not store form entries in browser storage. No online service can guarantee absolute security.

6. Your choices

You can contact us to ask about your information or request access, correction or deletion, subject to applicable legal requirements. You may use WhatsApp or email instead of the optional inquiry form. We may need to verify that the request relates to your information.

7. Cookies and optional analytics

No advertising trackers or optional analytics are enabled. Essential hosting and anti-abuse services may use technical identifiers needed to operate securely. We will update this notice before introducing optional tracking and obtain consent where required.

8. Contact and changes

Email orven.agency01@gmail.com for privacy questions. We update this notice when the website’s processing practices change.

Current website settings

This website does not load advertising trackers or optional analytics. Fonts and portfolio images are served locally. Form entries are not saved in browser storage. Cloudflare Turnstile checks form submissions to help prevent automated abuse. WhatsApp and email open only when you choose them.
